basis.statement: 量子力学・場の理論・繰り込みを一度学んだ、量子多体系・場の理論に関心のある大学院生。基本概念の定性的理解は残るが、規約と個別計算の細部は記憶に依存しない。

purpose: Understand the calculation and structure of Costello perturbative renormalization
concept_available: 零点振動・量子揺らぎの定性的理解
自由理論のガウス積分と相互作用の摂動展開という見方
繰り込みの目的の定性的理解
ゲージ自由度とゲージ固定の役割（QFT学習歴からの限定的推定）
detail_to_recover: source of coincident-point divergence in phi4 and local subtraction
conventions_to_supply: Gaussian covariance hbar*p, quartic normalization g/4!
graded signs and BV pairing conventions
new_or_unconfirmed: full functional-space topology; original theorem conditions retained

probes.criterion: No Born-rule/oscillator ground-state/complex-number reeducation at entrance
probes.observed: Begins with renormalization/effective interaction; no Born-rule or oscillator derivation.

probes.criterion: Show quartic quadratic coefficient and heat-kernel diagonal divergence rather than assume name implies knowledge
probes.observed: Recovers quartic coefficients, diagonal contraction, cutoff divergence and local subtraction.

probes.criterion: Specify covariance and action signs before averaging exponentials
probes.observed: Supplies covariance, normalization, exponent sign, formal parameter and graded conventions before calculations.

reader_fit.method: Independent authored-source review against explicit user contract
reader_fit.limit: Textual fit only; no claim of observed human comprehension
